reason: The sealed FallingBodies2D sentinel exposed a Release countdown rewrite that moved a loop-local call result before its definition.

subsequent_corrections.reason: The sealed FallingBodies2D sentinel exceeded the short COFF relocation count on Windows ARM64.
The sealed physics contact sentinel rejected the candidate runtime, and the correction campaign exposed an unsafe ARM64 reference-cache iteration before resuming qualification.
The physical macOS ARM64 FallingBodies2D Release sentinel exposed an unsafe post-layout aggregate-copy bypass that redirected call arguments to expired source storage.

The sealed physics contact execution witness retained a by-value aggregate copy whose sole use was a direct call; the correction forwards the unchanged source before register allocation and fuses non-power-of-two ARM64 list addresses.

The first forwarding revision left dead-copy removal in both native encoders and changed an earlier regression witness; the correction compacts the shared Machine IR and remaps every branch target before either backend allocates registers.

The sealed contact execution witness still paid a pointer round-trip for every two-slot collection view argument; the ARM64 internal ABI now flattens small aggregates into x0...x7 only when the complete signature fits the register window.

The first flattened-ABI revision precolored the hot parameters in their incoming registers, then cleared those residences with the legacy pointer-ABI conflict guard; the correction retains only exact incoming-to-residence matches and leaves unsafe permutations spilled.

The exact cumulative test run exposed that the direct ARM64 test runner still injected one pointer per source parameter after the internal ABI began flattening small aggregates; the correction expands those leaves like generated call sites and runs language tests from the isolated workspace root.
The blind physics integration workload exposed that branching callees mutating borrowed aggregates were excluded from control-flow inlining, leaving tens of millions of avoidable calls in hot loops.

The structural counterproof for branching reference inlining exposed that address-producing reference operations were admitted while their address value type was still rejected; the correction admits address parameters and temporaries consistently.

The focused physical integration campaign showed that forcing newly admitted branching reference callees to inline increased register pressure and worsened execution to 2.16x Clang; the correction retains small profitable helpers but subjects the new reference forms to the existing effect and pressure cost model.

The blind integration structure profile showed that recognizing more than one ascending checked view reference discarded every checked cursor, so two hot loops recomputed element addresses; the correction colors and emits every independent reference cursor together.

The blind preparation structure profile showed that every scalar leaf of a large read-only aggregate parameter was forced to stack storage before use; the correction keeps safe leaves eligible for ARM64 scalar registers while address-taking and whole-aggregate uses remain pinned.

The blind integration profile showed that a small branching position helper remained out of line solely because its proven system sqrt boundary was conservatively summarized like an arbitrary native call; the correction carries exact pure-boundary effects in portable IR so the hot cost model admits that helper without forcing the larger velocity helper.

The exact post-correction structure profile showed that the hot cost model still counted dead SSA identifiers left in the value-type table, rejecting the bounded position helper despite its proven pure math boundary; the correction measures only parameters, captures and instruction results that remain materialized, while the structural size ceiling continues to reject the larger velocity helper.

The exact cumulative build rejected the compact nested optional-value condition used while marking materialized SSA results; the correction uses an explicit block so the assignment has an unambiguous statement context.

The exact integration structure profile showed that a second bounded traversal kept its redundant collection check because a reused induction local had stores from the preceding loop; the correction proves zero origin from the nearest store on every external entry path while rejecting non-unit stores inside the current loop.

The focused physical integration campaign proved that moving a pure sqrt ABI boundary into the branching reference caller expanded its ARM64 frame and regressed execution to 2.06x Clang; the correction propagates native-call barriers through eligible callees and keeps newly supported reference CFGs containing them out of their callers while preserving exact semantic effects.

After restoring the safe partial-inlining baseline and removing the redundant sequential bound, the exact integration profile still executed two leaf calls per body and step at a descriptive 1.67x Clang; the correction admits an otherwise over-budget set only when every direct callee is a safe non-recursive leaf, at least one site is hot, no call is left outside the set, and the complete expansion remains under one cumulative ceiling.

The exact physical integration campaign proved that closing the complete hot leaf set removed both internal calls but expanded the ARM64 caller to 222 slots and a 1776-byte frame, regressing execution to 2.12x Clang and cold compilation to 1.24x; the correction restores the safe pressure budget and keeps the pressure-heavy call set as a preservation counterproof until expanded caller residences are proven profitable.

The exact ARM64 structure profiles showed that call-free Integration and Preparation kernels kept 203 of 222 and 208 of 242 virtual slots in registers, yet any remaining spill retained a frame through the final virtual identifier; the correction places addressable locals immediately after aggregate ABI values and sizes the physical frame only through the highest participating spill, without changing virtual identities or the internal ABI.

The exact structure profile proved that Preparation still retained all 242 slots and its 1936-byte frame because the final stack participant was hidden_return_slot 241, not an addressable local or a register-resident temporary; the physical campaign remained a stable 1.866320..1.890564x Clang, so the correction is revoked in full before targeting the actual aggregate-return anchor.

The exact Preparation machine profile showed that whole-element assignment loaded 26 discarded fields for its first bounds check, wrote the 26-field direct-call result into a hidden stack temporary, then copied it into the already-checked output view. The correction reuses that original checked access as the aggregate return destination only for an infallible plain-value callee whose address arguments originate in element types distinct from the result, retaining the temporary path whenever aliasing is possible.

The first cumulative check compiled the forwarding implementation and passed the full language corpus, but its new unit fixture returned slices backed by local arrays and therefore observed a corrupted Machine slot. The correction allocates every nested fixture slice in the test arena without changing generated-code behavior.

The real Preparation structure profile did not activate the forwarding proof even though the synthetic fixture reached its metadata path. The diagnostic correction makes the optional payload construction explicit, asserts the fixture's pre-optimization slot, and temporarily reports which conservative guard rejects the sealed workload.

The diagnostic structure profile proved that the sealed Preparation callee was rejected before caller-side alias analysis solely because its read-only @Input parameter is represented as an address. The correction admits borrowed parameters only in capture-free plain-value callees restricted to reference projections and loads, keeps every address argument subject to the distinct-element proof, and removes the temporary diagnostics.

The first exact cumulative check passed all 163 language tests and 1303 of 1304 Zig tests, but the compound optional forwarding payload retained function zero while exposing slot zero instead of slot ten. The correction stores the forwarded slot and function as separately typed optionals, validates that both are present or absent together, and preserves the same conservative activation proof.

The second exact cumulative check reproduced slot zero after splitting the optional payload, disproving the representation hypothesis. The correction changes perspective: because the checked aggregate load is already proven dead, its existing Machine span becomes the direct call result and replacement identity, so the encoder needs no auxiliary forwarded slot and the superseded aggregate temporary becomes genuinely unused before register allocation.

The third exact cumulative check proved that forwarding activated but the attempted call-or-replacement span reassignment did not survive: the fixture expected span seven and observed the original span ten. The correction keeps the call and replacement identities unchanged and instead lets the already-checked dead load adopt the call-result span, so the encoder stores the destination address exactly where the existing forwarded-call path reads it.

The fourth exact cumulative check preserved the scalar forwarding marker but left the checked-load span at seven after a whole-Span assignment intended to move it to ten. The correction assigns start, width and aggregate independently, matching the scalar mutations already proven to survive while leaving the alias and infallibility gates unchanged.

The fifth exact cumulative check showed that both whole-Span and leaf-wise mutations on a copied CollectionLoad payload left its pre-existing result at span seven, while the newly introduced scalar marker survived. The correction rebuilds the complete typed CollectionLoad payload from its source fields with the call-result span supplied at initialization, avoiding mutation-and-rewrap of an existing union payload.

A targeted single-module test finally separated fixture corruption from the optimizer proof. Several nested function type and Machine parameter slices still referenced temporary literals, and the final guard inverted spanUsed even though false means the replacement is the sole permitted user. The correction arena-owns every nested fixture slice and rejects only true unexpected-use results; the positive forwarding case and same-type alias counterproof both pass before cumulative qualification.

The exact Preparation structure profile proved that aggregate-result forwarding safely reused the checked destination, and the focused physical campaign improved the execution interval from 1.866320..1.890564x to 1.752104..1.792328x Clang without reaching parity. The remaining callee still retained a 1936-byte frame because hidden_return_slot 241 followed register-resident temporaries. The correction places aggregate ABI frame anchors before temporaries and sizes a call-free frame only through its highest participating spill.

The exact frame-anchor profile moved hidden_return_slot from 241 to 25 and reduced Preparation's frame from 1936 to 1680 bytes without changing any residence, but its focused physical campaign remained inconclusive with a descriptive 1.773x execution ratio. The same profile exposed 26 unresident slots for an aggregate_init immediately followed by its return even though the ARM64 encoder already skips that materialization and stores the fields directly into the hidden destination. The correction excludes only this control-flow-safe elided span from physical frame participation.

The exact structure profile proved that excluding the encoder-elided aggregate result span did not reduce Preparation's 1680-byte frame: a real stack-resident field operand at slot 208 remained the highest participant. The experiment is revoked in full without a physical campaign, preserving the tested frame-anchor placement while avoiding an analysis exception with no generated-code effect.

After the neutral return-home experiment was revoked, the exact Preparation profile showed that its final aggregate was assembled from 26 scalar copies even though the immediate-return encoder already consumes the fields directly. One copied field remained stack-resident at slot 208 and anchored the 1680-byte frame. The correction forwards only scalar copies whose sole user is that unbranched immediate aggregate return and whose source is not redefined, so liveness sees the authoritative operands and removes the redundant Machine instructions.
